deferred.screen content: Stage 4. Every screen currently renders its route and its component list; the 51 types in componentTypes are the worklist.
deferred.page titles: Stage 4. Titles are the humanized route segment; the real one is the screen's Heading key.
deferred.knockout screens: Stage 4. The 102 knockout screens are marked `class="df-knockout"` and gated like any other; they become <fg-alert knockout="true"> once their content exists.
deferred.collection item names: Stage 7. <fg-collection item-name> is the collection's own path segment, which is a slug rather than a word. The real name is a locale string.
deferred.collection hubs: Stage 7, and the port's largest open question. Direct File walks a loop item across many screens; Form Builder's <fg-collection> renders every item inline on one page. Each loop page therefore carries its own <fg-collection> here, which resolves the /*/ paths correctly but shows the add/remove control more than once.
deferred.setActions: Stage 4. 45 screens carry <SetFactAction>; <fg-apply> is the target.
